stories.headline: MKBHD Weighs In on the iPhone Duo
stories.summary: Tech reviewer Marques Brownlee shares his hands-on assessment of Apple's new foldable device. The review examines how the dual-screen hardware performs in everyday use alongside its custom software experience.

stories.headline: MKBHD Unboxes Apple's iPhone Duo
stories.summary: Tech creator Marques Brownlee gives viewers an ASMR unboxing experience of Apple's new device, the iPhone Duo. The video showcases the packaging and physical hardware details of the dual-device setup. Apple provided the units directly for review.

stories.headline: Hands-On With Apple's First Folding iPhone
stories.summary: The initial review explores what it is actually like to use Apple's debut folding phone, the iPhone Duo. The segment breaks down daily usability, design quirks, and first-generation hardware performance. It also includes promotional messages for accessories and merchandise.

stories.headline: Broken Bodies Make Beautiful Temples
Reflecting on Pastoral Legacy and Faith
stories.summary: This essay reflects on the foundational lessons of pastoral ministry passed down through generations. It explores enduring themes of faith, grace, and spiritual leadership within the church. The piece forms part of a broader collection of theological essays and commentaries.

stories.headline: Tesla's New Roadster Campaign Surprises MKBHD
stories.summary: Tech commentator MKBHD shares his unvarnished thoughts on Tesla's unexpected marketing push for the new Roadster. The reaction video explores why the non-traditional automaker shifted strategies to promote the high-performance vehicle. It also points viewers to additional automotive coverage from Hagerty.

stories.headline: Testing Obscure Foldable Phones
stories.summary: The Studio puts lesser-known foldable smartphones to the test to see how they stack up against industry giants. The hands-on overview explores unique hardware designs and niche features in the evolving foldable market.

stories.headline: The Surprising Tech Behind MKBHD's Studio Intro
stories.summary: The MKBHD studio team pulls back the curtain on their production setup, revealing the unexpected camera gear used to shoot their channel's intro. The breakdown highlights how high-end production values can come from unconventional hardware choices.

stories.headline: Weird Tech Products Worth Testing
stories.summary: The MKBHD studio crew dives into a roundup of bizarre and unconventional gadgets currently on the market. Instead of just mocking the strange designs, the team highlights which pieces of weird tech actually deliver functional utility.

stories.headline: Navigating Faith and Culture in Gen-Z Ministry
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition's latest collection of essays explores contemporary theological strategies and foundational Christian doctrines aimed at engaging modern generations. Contributors address enduring questions of faith, church history, and spiritual devotion in a rapidly changing cultural landscape.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Previews Packers-Lions Week 7 Matchup
stories.summary: CBS Sports provides betting odds, start times, and advanced model predictions for the Week 7 NFL showdown between the Green Bay Packers and the Detroit Lions. Fans and bettors can check the latest spreads and analytics ahead of the divisional clash.

stories.headline: NBA Clarity and Early Trends
stories.summary: A comprehensive look at recent NBA reporting highlights franchise organizational strategies and early-season adjustments. Notably, Orlando and Denver stood out on opening night as the only teams returning all five starters from the previous season.

stories.headline: Apple Celebrates iPod Anniversary With 404 Easter Egg
stories.summary: To mark the original iPod's 25th anniversary, Apple launched a fully functional, photo-realistic 3D model of the classic music player on its website's 404 error page. The clever Easter egg has quickly drawn praise from fans.

stories.headline: Cerebras Details Deployment of Trillion-Parameter AI Models
stories.summary: Cerebras outlined how it runs multi-trillion parameter open-source models like Kimi K3 across wafer-scale WSE-3T chips. By utilizing 4-bit weight quantization, the architecture fits roughly 16 GB per model layer onto individual wafers. This strategy enables high-speed inference of 1,000 to 2,000+ tokens per second for massive models.

stories.headline: Understanding the Hebrew Roots Movement
stories.summary: An exploratory piece examines the theological underpinnings and growth of the Hebrew Roots Movement within contemporary religious circles. It breaks down the core beliefs, practices, and distinct perspectives that separate the movement from traditional Christian denominations.

stories.headline: Seven Essential Keys to Lifelong Ministry
stories.summary: A practical guide outlines seven foundational principles designed to help ministry leaders sustain their calling over a lifetime of service. The framework focuses on spiritual resilience, personal health, and navigating the long-term demands of leadership.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence Newsletter Covers Early NBA Trends
stories.summary: The latest Basketball Intelligence newsletter breaks down early-season NBA storylines, featuring analysis on rookie performances from the 2026 draft class and tracking data insights from Week 1. It also highlights league-wide trends and game notes from around the association.

stories.headline: The Art History Roots of iPhone Portrait Mode
stories.summary: Reflecting on a decade of iPhone Portrait Mode, developer Johnnie Manzari revealed that the feature's breakthrough came from studying traditional oil painting techniques rather than pure math. By using machine learning to protect subjects' eyes and strategically increasing background blur, Apple successfully masked digital depth-calculation artifacts.

stories.headline: Argus Launches Open-Source Security Platform for AI Agents
stories.summary: Argus has released an open-source security operations platform designed to defend cloud, identity, and network infrastructure against agentic attacks at machine speed. The self-hosted tool uses specialist AI agents for read-only triage while keeping human operators in control via automated, reversible playbooks.

stories.headline: Anthropic Quietly Nerfs Claude’s Reverse-Engineering Powers
stories.summary: Users report that Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 model has been stealthily updated to trigger safety guardrails when prompted to reverse-engineer software and intellectual property. The silent nerf follows a wave of viral projects where the AI was used to recompile games and modify smart TV firmware.

stories.headline: Decade-Old CNN Beats Frontier LLMs in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
stories.summary: A test of 200 biopsy-proven skin lesions revealed that a fine-tuned Inception v3 convolutional neural network from 2015 outperformed cutting-edge LLMs like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 in identifying skin cancer. While the 10-year-old CNN correctly diagnosed 62 percent of the cases, the frontier language models managed only 42 percent.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Releases Week 7 NFL Predictions and Odds
stories.summary: CBS Sports has published its comprehensive breakdown of NFL Week 7 odds, predictions, and against-the-spread picks. The slate features marquee matchups like the Packers-Lions showdown and tests whether the surging Texans can keep their momentum going. Bettors and analysts weigh in on the key games shaping the middle stretch of the season.

stories.headline: Revisiting Ne-Yo's 2006 Breakthrough Debut Album
stories.summary: Pitchfork examines Ne-Yo's 2006 debut album, In My Own Words, highlighting his distinct entry into R&B as a songwriter-first artist. Moving away from the physical bravado of his contemporaries, Ne-Yo established a brand of empathetic, supportive storytelling. His songwriting success with hits like Mario's "Let Me Love You" ultimately secured his own recording contract with Def Jam.

stories.headline: Musk Confirms SpaceX Restricted Starlink for Ukraine Amid Military Use Dispute
stories.summary: Elon Musk acknowledged that SpaceX restricted Ukraine's civilian Starlink service after arguing that Kyiv violated terms of agreement by using it for offensive drone strikes. The admission follows a dispute over connectivity issues that Ukrainian officials claimed hampered defensive operations for over a week.

stories.headline: Review Highlights Ergonomic Drawbacks of the New Duo
stories.summary: Reviewer Nicole Nguyen points out that the new Duo feels noticeably heavier, wider, and thicker than a Pro iPhone. She notes that using the device one-handed in phone mode causes physical hand strain.

stories.headline: Foldable Screens on iPhone Duo Reportedly Crack Within Hours
stories.summary: Just hours after launch, multiple iPhone Duo owners reported inner display failures, complete with audible cracking sounds along the hinge and bright horizontal lines across the glass. Several posts on Reddit show damaged units breaking during ordinary opening motions on day one. Apple Stores have reportedly provided immediate replacements for affected customers as early hardware scrutiny mounts.

stories.headline: Tim Pan’s iPhone Duo Review
Apple Designer Reveals the Mechanics Behind the iPhone Duo Hinge Animation
stories.summary: Apple designer Chan Karunamuni detailed the visual trickery behind the newly unveiled iPhone Duo's open and close transition. Rather than distorting the on-screen content, the software perceptually adjusts the focal plane to make the dual screens feel like opening a window onto a singular canvas. Karunamuni highlighted deep cross-functional collaboration across hardware and software teams to achieve the seamless effect.

stories.headline: Nikon Scientific Photography Winner Striped of Title Over AI Use
stories.summary: Dr. Ning Xu has been stripped of first place in Nikon's Small World in Motion contest after scientists identified telltale signs of artificial intelligence in his microscopic video. Researchers flagged structural anomalies, vanishing cell features, and a watermark indicative of AI generation. While Xu claimed AI was only used during post-processing to clarify grayscale images, the entry failed to meet the competition's authenticity standards.

stories.headline: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
Serbia Faces High Voter Turnout as Opposition Seeks to Oust Longtime Leader
stories.summary: Serbian parliamentary elections have drawn a heavy voter turnout, with participation reaching 46% early in the day as a student-led anti-corruption movement challenges President Aleksandar Vučić. The snap vote follows years of mounting public anger sparked by the deadly 2024 train station canopy collapse in Novi Sad.

stories.headline: Seven Missing After High-Rise Collapses in Nairobi
stories.summary: A multi-storey building under construction in Nairobi's Eastleigh neighborhood abruptly collapsed, leaving seven people feared trapped beneath the rubble. While dozens of construction workers escaped safely, officials noted that ground-floor shops had opened without proper occupancy permits, reigniting scrutiny over lax building standards.

stories.headline: Venezuelan Opposition Leader María Corina Machado Returns After Ten Months in Exile
stories.summary: Venezuelan opposition figure María Corina Machado has returned to the country following ten months abroad, making her first public appearance at a church in Lara State. Her return creates a direct political challenge for interim President Delcy Rodríguez, who assumed power after U.S. forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January.

stories.headline: Democrats Target Western Senate Seats via Independents
stories.summary: With party branding struggling across parts of the American West, national Democrats are eyeing independent candidates in states like Nebraska and Montana to boost their Senate majority odds. Campaigns like Navy veteran Dan Osborn's in Nebraska highlight how outsider candidates are trying to carve out a viable path. Democrats hope these independent bids can successfully flip crucial seats from Republican incumbents.

stories.headline: Democrats Target Deep-Red Arkansas in Midterm Push
stories.summary: Seeking to capitalize on a difficult political climate for the ruling party, Democrats are mounting unexpected challenges in ruby-red Arkansas during the 2026 midterms. Senate candidate Hallie Shoffner is hitting the campaign trail to pitch voters on economic relief and push back against congressional gridlock. Republicans have already been forced to spend heavily to defend seats in a state where Donald Trump won overwhelmingly just two years prior.

stories.headline: Nigeria Village Raid Death Toll Reaches 48
stories.summary: Police in Taraba state confirm that the death toll from a weekend motorcycle raid by unidentified gunmen on Binnari village has climbed to 48, with Amnesty International citing 52 local deaths. The attackers spent hours looting shops and setting homes ablaze while residents fled into nearby bushes and rivers.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Previews Sunday Night Football Clash Between Seahawks and Chiefs
stories.summary: Betting analysts and sports experts have released their latest predictions, odds, and spread picks for Sunday's matchup between the Seattle Seahawks and Kansas City Chiefs. The breakdown highlights key trends and expert selections for the high-stakes prime-time game.

stories.headline: 2026 Week 7 NFL odds, picks, predictions, best bets: Experts backing Lions, Raiders, Seahawks on Sunday
Week 7 Fantasy Football rankings update
Premier League Approaches Peak Manager Sacking Season
stories.summary: As autumn progresses, Premier League clubs historically ramp up managerial changes, with November and December accounting for nearly a third of all in-season departures. Manchester United's Michael Carrick and other struggling bosses face mounting pressure as this volatile period approaches.

stories.headline: Week 7 NFL betting odds, spreads, totals, lines for every game, including Lions-Packers, Chiefs-Seahawks
Apple Executive Greets Customers at Austin Launch
stories.summary: Footage shows Apple CEO Ternus welcoming customers outside an Austin, Texas, retail location to celebrate the latest product launch. Crowds gathered as the executive interacted with shoppers during the busy opening event.

stories.headline: Israel Shuts West Bank Crossings and Bars Workers Amid Crackdown
stories.summary: The Israeli military is closing all West Bank land crossings and barring Palestinian workers from settlements during Tuesday's election. The sweeping restrictions and home demolitions in Hebron follow a deadly shooting attack that killed two Israeli soldiers.

stories.headline: Gabon Lifts Eight-Month Social Media Ban
stories.summary: Gabon's High Communication Authority has restored access to social media platforms following an eight-month blackout originally imposed during a period of civil unrest. The ban had blocked popular apps like Facebook and TikTok, forcing citizens to rely on VPNs. The restriction was enacted under President Brice Oligui Nguema, who faced widespread criticism and accusations of abusing power.

stories.headline: Nearly 1,000 Arrested During Fresh Protests Across France
stories.summary: French authorities arrested roughly 1,000 people as hundreds of thousands participated in widespread protests over living costs and school conditions. Police deployed tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds after skirmishes and property damage erupted in cities like Paris and Marseille.

stories.headline: Israel Heads to Pivotal Polls Following Years of Post-Oct. 7 Conflict
stories.summary: Israelis are casting ballots in a high-stakes general election that pits longtime Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu against center-right challenger Gadi Eisenkot. Voters face a fundamental choice on whether to maintain Netanyahu's nationalist coalition and military campaigns or shift leadership in the wake of the October 7 attacks.

stories.headline: Celtics Navigate Early Drama and Defeat the Knicks
stories.summary: Jayson Tatum addressed lingering offseason chatter regarding teammate Jaylen Brown, insisting there is no rift between them after a strong home-opening victory over the New York Knicks. Tatum delivered a clutch performance down the stretch to secure the 107-103 win for Boston.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Evaluates AP Top 25 Marquee Matchups
stories.summary: CBS Sports reviews the current AP Top 25 college football rankings to analyze how early marquee wins have held up over the course of the season. The evaluation highlights which high-profile victories have aged well and which have lost their luster.

stories.headline: Nikola Jokić Tells Booing Nuggets Fans They Are Not Welcome
stories.summary: Denver Nuggets star Nikola Jokić blasted home fans who booed the team during a comeback win against the New Orleans Pelicans. Jokić stated that supporters who jeer during struggles do not deserve to be part of the team's success. The remarks highlight mounting tensions between the roster and the home crowd.

stories.headline: SUNNNY Introduces B2B Customer Data Consolidation Tool
stories.summary: SUNNNY has launched a new B2B software platform designed to aggregate, clean, and resolve customer data across disparate enterprise systems for teams and AI models. The company promises strict data privacy, allowing clients to manage their own encryption keys without training external models.
